literal: face having-looked to-stand will-suffice mind having-looked what-occurred those-who-understand if-obtained
translation: If one secures those who can look into the mind and understand what has happened, it is enough to simply stand looking at their face.
modern: ஒருவருடைய உள்ளத்தை ஆராய்ந்து அவருக்கு நேர்ந்ததை உணரும் ஆற்றல் உடையவர்களைத் துணையாகப் பெற்றால், அவர்கள் முகத்தைப் பார்த்துக்கொண்டு அமைதியாக நின்றாலே போதும்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the value of companions who can read one's mind. If a person has advisors who can understand their inner thoughts and feelings just by observing, there is no need for words. It is entirely sufficient to simply stand before them and look at their face, as they will instantly grasp what needs to be done.
